title: THE GARAGE HYROX · 8 STATIONS × 8 RUN LEGS · 60:00
vibe: GREEN · 60 MIN · HARD, RUN-INTERLEAVED, FULL KIT AT HOME
why: Three days off and 8 hours of sleep, so today is a full-effort HYROX-style race on your own gear: eight 0.25 mi run legs, each followed by a station that mirrors a HYROX event. Heavy swings, high pulls, thrusters and jumps come back after three weeks of hotel dumbbells; a dragon-flag midline closes it.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 8 MIN · ANKLES, KNEES, SHOULDERS
blocks.meta: ONE PASS · Moves Method Day B (run + leg day)

items.name: Toe squats x10 + ankle rolls in the squat x10 each way
Single-leg squat to the bench x5/side
Knee drives x10/side
items.detail: standing, hug the knee high, then drive

items.name: Side step-ups on the bench x8/side
Rehearsal: dead-stop swing 60 x5, double KB thruster 2x45 x3, double KB high pull 2x45 x5, burpee broad jump x2
items.detail: groove the new ones before the clock

blocks.text: Set up before the clock: the 60 at the treadmill end, 2x45 and the 35 at the far end, Tonal rope on the high arm for the ski pull, low arm for the rope pull, bench clear.

blocks.title: THE RACE · 8 ROUNDS · RUN 0.25 MI THEN A STATION · ~35:00
blocks.meta: 8 ROUNDS · one clock, no rest between legs · every run leg 0.25 mi @ 8.0 console (about 7:10/mi on the watch) · record total race time
blocks.format: HYROX-style gauntlet: run leg then station, eight times (Neupert Super Circuit density, stations exited by runs)

items.name: S1 · Tonal rope ski pull x40
items.detail: SkiErg: straight arms, rope from overhead to the hips, hinge hard; find the weight that makes 40 ugly

items.name: S2 · Bear-hug squat, 60 lb KB x15
items.detail: sled push: bell crushed to the chest, elbows in, full depth, drive

items.name: S3 · Tonal hand-over-hand rope pull x20 pulls
items.detail: WILDCARD, sled pull: sit back in a half squat, haul the rope hand over hand, heavy

items.name: S4 · Burpee broad jump x10
items.detail: chest to floor, stand, jump for distance, land soft

items.name: S5 · Dead-stop swing, 60 lb KB x20
items.detail: park the bell every rep, re-hike, snap the hips

items.name: S6 · Double KB high pull 2x45 x15
items.detail: elbows high and outside, bells to chest height, hips do the work

items.name: S7 · Overhead reverse lunge, 35 lb KB x8/side
items.detail: sandbag lunges: bell locked out overhead, knee kisses the floor, switch arms at 8

items.name: S8 · Double KB thruster 2x45 x15
items.detail: wall balls: squat, then drive the bells overhead in one motion, breathe at the top

blocks.text: 8.0 on the console is about a 7:10 mile on the watch; hold it, do not race the belt faster until leg 8. Cadence 168 plus. Stations are unbroken if you can; break them only in 2 pieces. Write the total race time and which station cost the most.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 2 ROUNDS · 8 MIN
blocks.meta: 2 ROUNDS · rest 30 s between rounds · anti-extension and anti-rotation

items.name: Dragon flag negative x5
items.detail: on the bench, grip behind the head, lower straight for a 5 count

items.name: Tall-kneeling Pallof press on the Tonal x10/side
items.detail: knees down, press out, 2-count hold at arm's length

items.name: Lying leg raise with the 35 between the feet x10
items.detail: low back pinned, legs to vertical, lower slow

items.name: L-sit on the two 45s, 20 s
items.detail: hands on the handles, legs straight out; tuck knees if the legs drop

blocks.text: Dragon flag: hips stay in line with the shoulders the whole way down. Record the Pallof weight.

blocks.title: COOLDOWN · 4 MIN
blocks.meta: walk 1:30 @ 3.0, couch stretch 45 s/side, 90-90 hip stretch 30 s/side
blocks.text: Record: total race time, run leg speed held, Tonal weights on the ski pull and row, whether the stations stayed unbroken, RPE. If you did the 11-18 PRESS DECK, send its numbers too.
